item.description:
## Improved - The gesture steps of the tour now say what to do: press Unlock gestures to let Butterfly read the trackpad, and use Control + Option with ← or → if you have no trackpad. - Asking for Accessibility now shows a single macOS prompt instead of the prompt and System Settings at the same time. The permissions window also says which switch to turn on. - The Butterfly menu shows how many trial days are left from the first day, and Settings shows the price next to it: $4.99 until November 30, then $7.99 for one Mac.
## Fixed - If you skipped the tour before allowing Accessibility, Butterfly now shows how to move between windows as soon as tiling starts.

## New - Need more time? When your trial ends, you can get 3 more days once, right from the trial window. - In the last days of your trial, Butterfly reminds you once with a small note at the bottom of the screen, and only when you are not moving windows or on a call.
## Improved - The launch price of $4.99 lasts until Monday, November 30. After that Butterfly costs from $7.99, still a one-time purchase with no subscription. The license window now shows this, along with how many hours Butterfly has kept your windows on the strip. - In the last 3 days of your trial, the Butterfly menu shows how many days are left with a Buy button. Before, it showed only on the last day.

## Fixed - A window that can't get narrower, like WhatsApp, no longer pushes its neighbour off the screen. When two windows share a small screen half and half and one of them needs more room, the other one gives up the difference, so both stay fully visible and clicking between them no longer scrolls the strip. Before, the neighbour next to a second monitor could disappear completely.
